background: BNP Paribas is the largest bank in the eurozone, a universal bank with retail networks in France, Belgium, Italy and Luxembourg, a large corporate and investment bank, and consumer finance, leasing and asset management arms.
synthesis: Ratings are strong at AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable. The ratios, though, are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers across the board: CET1 of 13.0% and leverage of 4.4% are both in the bottom quarter against the peer medians, and LCR of 135% and NSFR of 109% are likewise in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is good, with profit up by a third on 22 Jul 2026. Scale and diversification, not ratio headroom, are what the ratings rest on.
